name: Jiangsu X-chip Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu X-chip Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. engages in research and development, design, testing, and sales of analog chips and micro-modules. Its analog chip products primarily focus on power management chips, with sub-products including DC/DC converters, linear regulators (LDOs), load switches, and drain modulation chips. Its micro-module products can perform various functions such as isolated and non-isolated DC/DC conversion, logic control, signal modulation, and diode control. The company also provides discrete device products to its customers.
